items.label: Open QueueIQ
items.description: Prioritized mod queue, mod actions, and refresh — in the dashboard post.

items.label: QueueIQ score
items.description: See why this post or comment ranks where it does.

bannedKeywords.label: Banned keywords (comma-separated)
bannedKeywords.helpText: Matched against post titles/bodies and comment text. Each match is scored using Points per banned keyword below.
bannedKeywords.defaultValue: spam, scam, phishing, giveaway, free money

lowKarmaThreshold.label: Low karma threshold
lowKarmaThreshold.helpText: Authors below this total karma (link + comment) receive the Low-karma author bonus below.

scoreWeightReports.label: Points per report
scoreWeightReports.helpText: Multiplied by report count (decimals allowed, e.g. 2.5). Change here, then refresh the dashboard.

scoreWeightKeywords.label: Points per banned keyword
scoreWeightKeywords.helpText: Multiplied by keyword matches in title/body (decimals allowed).

scoreWeightLowKarma.label: Low-karma author bonus
scoreWeightLowKarma.helpText: Flat points when author is below the karma threshold (decimals allowed).

scoreWeightRepeatReports.label: Points per repeat report
scoreWeightRepeatReports.helpText: Multiplied by extra report events beyond the first (decimals allowed).

scoreWeightQueueAge.label: Points per hour in queue
scoreWeightQueueAge.helpText: Older mod-queue items score higher, capped at 7 days (decimals allowed).

scoreWeightYoungAccount.label: Young account bonus
scoreWeightYoungAccount.helpText: Flat bonus when author account is newer than the threshold below (decimals allowed).

youngAccountMaxDays.label: Young account max age (days)
youngAccountMaxDays.helpText: Authors with accounts newer than this many days get the young-account bonus.

scoreWeightModReports.label: Points per mod report
scoreWeightModReports.helpText: Bonus when moderators (not users) reported the item (decimals allowed).

flairWeightRules.label: Flair bonus rules
flairWeightRules.helpText: Comma-separated flair:points pairs, e.g. News:10.5, Meme:2.5. Matches post flair text.

autoRemoveAboveScore.label: Auto-remove at score (0 = off)
autoRemoveAboveScore.helpText: If greater than 0, each queue refresh may REMOVE mod-queue items whose QueueIQ total score is at or above this number (decimals allowed, max 500). Uses normal remove + mod note. Caps at 15 items per refresh. False positives are possible — start high, use Min reports below, and watch the audit log.

autoRemoveMinReports.label: Auto-remove: min user reports
autoRemoveMinReports.helpText: Only when auto-remove score is enabled. Require at least this many user reports before auto-removing (0 = score only, higher false-positive risk).
